slides.text: You haven't texted your brother in three years.
You type. You delete. You wait for him to go first.
Christmas 1914. Enemies lay in trenches, sometimes only 30 yards apart.
Then someone stood up. Unarmed. Not knowing if he'd be shot.
Within minutes, no man's land was full of men shaking hands.
They crossed no man's land. You only have to press send.
Who should stand up first in your family?

firstComment: Hand on heart: who should you text this Christmas? 👀
